title: State v. Scriven (N.J. 2016)
key_points: Holding: Driving with high beams on is not a violation of the high-beam statute unless there is oncoming traffic; a stop on that basis was invalid.
officer_notes: Scenario: You stop a car on an empty road at night because its high beams were on.
Takeaway: Make sure the conduct you saw actually violates the statute's terms.
